name: Clerk authentication
manualSteps: Wrap the existing root layout children with AppIntegrationsProvider when using compose, or AppAuthProvider when using add; do not replace the layout.
Adjust the protected route matcher to the product's real private routes.
Run npx clerk init or configure Google and phone sign-in in the Clerk Dashboard.
Wrap the existing React root with AppIntegrationsProvider when using compose, or AppAuthProvider when using add.
Add Clerk sign-in and sign-up components to the application's existing router instead of replacing it.
Configure social and phone sign-in in the Clerk Dashboard.
Mount clerkAuthMiddleware before routes and other authentication middleware.
Use requireClerkAuth on protected API resources and reconcile it deliberately with any existing JWT middleware.
Configure the same Clerk application used by the frontend; do not expose CLERK_SECRET_KEY to the browser.
